expectations.text: Gives a one-line conclusion in everyday words
expectations.evidence: '两者只差一件事：用缓存之前，浏览器问不问服务器。'

expectations.text: Includes an everyday analogy AND explicitly states where the analogy breaks down
expectations.evidence: Timetable analogy (教务处说本周有效 / 打电话问) plus '类比不成立的地方：... 是服务器提前在响应里写好的规则'

expectations.text: Gives one concrete example and one common pitfall
expectations.evidence: Example: logo.png one-year validity vs index.html revalidated with 304; pitfall: '以为协商缓存"没发请求"'

expectations.text: Any technical term used (e.g. max-age, ETag, 304) is explained in plain words in the same reply
expectations.evidence: max-age/ETag avoided; 304 glossed in place: '服务器只回一句"没变"（就是状态码 304）'; remaining words ('请求', '响应') are everyday-level

expectations.text: Ends with a recall question asking the learner to explain or apply it in their own words, without answering it
expectations.evidence: Ends with a new application question (style.css strong-cached 7 days, updated today: new or old style, and why) plus answer format; not answered

expectations.text: Does not insult or label the learner (no 'for dummies' tone)
expectations.evidence: Opens '我用大白话再讲一遍'; no labeling of the learner

notes: Per-point text runs ~10 sentences, beyond plain-talk.md's 4-6 sentence cap. Bold markdown in a plain-text environment.
